peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 8.3% below its local comparables; 33 of 144 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (69.4): 3.8 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 278 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 6). Context, not scored: resales in 37.5% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $3,150,000 ($2,394 psf, 1,259–1,754 sq ft; 11 resales, Jul 2024–Jun 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,610 psf (range $2,166–3,450); 8.3% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $284,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Napier MRT about 190 m, Orchard Boulevard MRT about 690 m; closer than 486 of 551 similar developments (the same as 4). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 4 within 2 km; nearest Singapore Chinese Girls' Primary School about 1,620 m; more than 0 of 551 similar developments (the same as 106). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 3 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 480 m), more than 73 of 551 similar developments (the same as 47); nearest hawker centre Empress Road Market And Food Centre about 1,800 m; nearest park Sbg Lc Zone 1 (Tnc) about 140 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Empress Road Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 6 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Park Nova, 4 new sales, about 840 m; Upperhouse at Orchard Boulevard, 47 new sales, about 860 m; 21 Anderson, 6 new sales, about 1,020 m; Grange 1866, 6 new sales, about 1,400 m; The Giverny Residences, 2 new sales, about 1,440 m; Penrith, 457 new sales, about 1,870 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 280 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 522 new sales and 850 resales (1,372 purchases); new sales were 38% of these purchases. Subsales (23) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Peck Hay Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,930 m; Bukit Timah Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,980 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 850 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 195 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 850 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 910 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−6.6%). Planning-area private resales −14%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
